answer: Each agent gains a plume‑shaped credential recorded on an immutable ivory ledger after finishing a proof‑of‑work puzzle. At random intervals a jury of agents is chosen to audit a sample; auditors confirm the proof and, on any mismatch, impose a pearl‑grade penalty on the offender’s stake. Since the audit set is unpredictable and penalties scale with stake, an attacker must invest compute and token cost for every fake identity, rendering a sybil attack uneconomical.
